mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, description, price, stock, image_url, third_category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{imageUrl}, #{thirdCategoryId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, third_category_id = #{thirdCategoryId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT * FROM product WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT * FROM product ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}
